purpose: 9.1 EXACT DIRECT scorer contribution (one field group zeroed in the candidate's OWN breakdown, no rebuild, no pairing) and 9.2 EXACT FIXED-CANDIDATE PARTITION contribution (all declared crowding fields replaced by production's zero-crowding values, every other field byte-identical). No residual is computed, because a residual is not evidence.
exactness: `scoreDecision` is a linear sum of the breakdown fields followed by one round2, so a single-field substitution measures that field's contribution exactly to the scorer's own precision. Nothing here is estimated, ratio-scaled or reconstructed.
unmeasuredChannels: Nested composites reached ONLY through another breakdown field (crowding inside `explorationValue`, `expectedFutureValue`, `recoveryBenefit`) are measured through the PARTITION metric, which replaces those composite fields wholesale, and are NOT separable into their own named direct path without rebuilding the candidate.

`getBadSiteStuckResidencePenalty` reads crowdingPenalty/rangeSaturation/socialAccessRisk/mobilityPressure off the breakdown and is applied OUTSIDE `scoreDecision`. It is captured in `externalAddition` and any arm-to-arm difference makes the pair contaminated rather than being folded into an attributed total.

selfConsistency.detail: no candidate of a band with weightedCrowding 0 may carry a non-zero direct scorer contribution
no candidate of a band with weightedCrowding 0 may carry a non-zero fixed-candidate partition contribution
a clean partition must reconstruct the control breakdown exactly, proving the manifest is complete for it
attributableTotal must be null whenever the pair is unpairable or contaminated
every field that moves between the full and zero-crowding candidate must be declared in the manifest
a duplicate candidate key must be rejected, never silently collapsed

the per-group partition contributions must sum to the whole-partition total within the PROVEN round2 budget of 0.01 x (groups + 1) = 0.07, proving nothing is left over and nothing is double-counted. Observed max discrepancy: 0.03
the partition groups must be pairwise disjoint and their union must equal the declared manifest exactly, or the group sum is not a partition of the total and SC7's linearity argument fails
a zero-substitution group must contain only fields whose entire value IS the crowding quantity, so a band with no neighbours must measure exactly 0 on every one of them
